ask: I'm a coach. I need to see for each client how many sessions they bought, used and have left, and who I should re-engage.
title: Client package tracker
for_whom: a solo coach tracking session packages for their clients
screens: one page: a form to add a client with sessions bought; a table of clients with bought, used, left and a +1 used button; a 'Re-engage' list of clients with 2 or fewer sessions left
data: per client: name, sessions bought, sessions used; kept in the coach's own browser
done_when: adding a client with 10 sessions shows them in the table with 10 left
pressing +1 used lowers sessions left by one
a client with 2 or fewer sessions left appears in the Re-engage list
the client list is still there after a page reload
out_of_scope: payments, invoices, client logins, email reminders
